capabilities: chat with a vault agent from the sidebar or a note selection
read, list, and write notes through local vault tools
route image-generation prompts to an image model endpoint
query .parquet and .sql files in a bundled DuckDB view
run local semantic vault search with Ollama embeddings
disambiguation: Not a vault-sharing or sync service despite the name; it is an in-vault AI agent.
extras: README is in German. The Obsidian community installer ships only main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css, so the ~36 MB duckdb/ runtime folder must be copied manually for the DuckDB view. Usage is metered via prepaid tokens ('Token aufladen'). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Write confirmation dialogs are enabled by default for new installs; the README documents token/byte limits, abort behavior, and privacy caveats of the private-cloud template.
